product.title: Lake Austin Scenic History Tour 2Hr. Fully Shaded. AM, PM, Sunset

description.text: Cruise Lake Austin on a fully shaded pontoon for a two-hour scenic history tour. Guides cover lakeside estates, cliffside homes, and landmarks such as Pennybacker Bridge while you stay cool under canopy cover on morning, afternoon, or sunset departures. Stops include Lake Austin Dock, Pennybacker Bridge, Lake Austin Shoreline, Scenic Return. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on Austin skyline views, lake corridors, and Hill Country highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Austin who want a guided Capital City experience without coordinating meeting points, trailheads, or photo locations on their own.
